description: Variable-speed pump in the chiller plant. One type serves three roles (review A1): primary CHW pumps R_CP1-4, condenser-water pumps R_CP5-8 and the secondary distribution pump R_CP9. An asset connects either its chw or its cw ports; defaults are sized for a primary CHW pump.

impeller_wear.description: Worn impeller: the pump develops less head at the same speed.

head_fraction.description: Head delivered as a fraction of the healthy curve.

trip.description: Motor or drive trips; the pump stops and ignores its command until reset.

name: Chiller plant pump

dp_nominal.description: Pump head at nominal flow (the curve is scaled from it).

m_flow_nominal.description: Design flow: one chiller's evaporator flow (site data: plant-design.json basis.capacities: 3,500 kW, CHW 14 / 20 degC). Condenser pumps override to 195 kg/s.

speed.description: Speed command as a fraction of full speed.

v_trip_pu.description: Undervoltage trip: the drive stops below this supply voltage.

water_in.description: Makeup / pressurisation water into the closed loop at the pump suction.
